title: tasks/model arch should be confirmed after user providing data
body:
![image](https://github.com/MLSysOps/MLE-agent/assets/5894780/b1fdeb6f-57a0-4b24-ba27-fa6c01ebd186)

if we generate a task/model arch just with blur requirement and without data, the generated tasks will be very general.

in the above case, I want to have a sentiment analysis task rather than tabular task

linked_prs.title: [MRG] improve the task, model planner for csv examples
